equationblock: Show me the quadratic formula. Write out E=mc² or Newton's second law; renders any math notation as a clean typeset equation with an optional explanatory caption.
numberline: Show -3 to 5 on a number line. Where does 2/3 fall? Mark the solution set x > -2. Plots points, ranges, and directional arrows on a horizontal scale.
workedexample: Solve this step by step. Walk me through finding the derivative. Show the full working for this integral. Numbered solution steps each showing the formula, substituted values, and a plain explanation.
quiz: Quiz me on photosynthesis. Give me a practice question about World War II. Test my understanding of Newton's laws. An interactive multiple-choice question with selectable options and an explanation on reveal.
flashcard: Make a flashcard for mitochondria. Help me memorize Spanish vocab. Give me a flip card for this formula. Question on the front, answer on the back — tap to reveal; works for vocab, facts, or formulas.
molecularstructure: Draw the molecular structure of caffeine. What does aspirin look like? Show me the skeletal formula of glucose. Computes accurate 2-D bond geometry from a SMILES string — atoms, bonds, and formula.
periodictable: Show me the periodic table. Where do transition metals sit? Highlight the halogens and noble gases. All 118 elements arranged by group and period, with cells highlighted by category or property.
bodymap: Where is the quadriceps? Highlight the shoulder muscles. Show the digestive organs on a body diagram. Named regions marked on a front or back human figure — anatomy, muscle groups, or injury sites.
geometrycanvas: Draw a right triangle with legs 3 and 4. Show two parallel lines cut by a transversal. Plot a circle with radius 5. Geometric figures on a labeled x-y grid with angles, points, and dimensions marked.
freebodydiagram: Draw the free body diagram for a box on an inclined plane. What forces act on a falling object? Show the FBD of a car accelerating. Named force arrows radiating from a labeled object at correct angles with optional magnitudes.
musicstaff: Write middle C on a staff. Show the C major scale on a treble clef. Notate these four notes for me. A 5-line staff with clef, time signature, note heads, stems, accidentals, and ledger lines drawn.
vectorspace: Show vector addition graphically. Draw the eigenvectors of this matrix. Visualize a linear transformation on 2-D vectors. Colored arrows from the origin with optional post-transform dashed arrows and span shading.
reactionmechanism: Show the mechanism for an SN2 reaction. Draw the steps of an aldol condensation. What happens in nucleophilic addition? Reaction intermediates linked by curved arrows with reagents and conditions above each step.
chorddiagram: How do I play a G major chord on guitar? Show me the fingering for Cadd9. What's the F chord shape? Fretboard grid with numbered finger dots, open-string circles, and muted-string markers.
developmentmilestone: What should a 2-year-old be able to do? When do babies start talking or walking? What are the 18-month milestones? Developmental checkpoints across motor, language, social, and cognitive domains by age.
teachdiagram: Animate how this proof builds up step by step. Show me a circuit being assembled piece by piece. An auto-playing figure where each step draws in new shapes and labels, paced to speaking time.
gridmatrix: Make a Punnett square for Aa × Aa. Show the multiplication table for 6. Draw a truth table for AND. A labeled rows-and-columns grid with headers — Punnett squares, times tables, truth tables, ten-frames.
fractionbar: Show 3/4 on a fraction bar. Compare 1/2 and 2/3 side by side. Which is bigger, 3/5 or 5/8? Segmented bars and optional pies for one or more fractions to make part-whole relationships visible.
wave: Draw a sine wave with amplitude 3 and wavelength 4. Label the crest, trough, and wavelength on a wave. Show how two waves compare. A labeled oscillation curve with marked amplitude A and wavelength λ.
energydiagram: Draw the energy profile for an exothermic reaction. Show the activation energy barrier. How does a catalyst change the energy diagram? Reaction-coordinate curve with transition-state peak, Ea, and ΔH labeled.
phylotree: Show the evolutionary relationship between birds and reptiles. Which organisms share a most recent common ancestor? A cladogram with taxa at the tips and shared ancestor nodes at each branching point.
parsetree: Diagram this sentence. Show the parse tree for 'The cat sat on the mat'. Label the noun phrase and verb phrase. A top-down syntax tree with phrase nodes (S, NP, VP, PP) branching down to the words.
celldiagram: Draw a labeled animal cell. Show a plant cell diagram with all the organelles. Where is the Golgi apparatus? A schematic cell with recognizable organelle glyphs and leader-line labels — animal or plant.
raydiagram: Draw the ray diagram for a convex lens with an object 20 cm away. Where does the image form? Show image formation in a concave mirror. Construction rays to focal points with the image position solved from the lens equation.
vectorfield: Draw the slope field for dy/dx = y. Show the electric field around a point charge. Visualize the gradient ∇f of this function. A lattice of directional arrows or dashes at each grid point with optional solution curves.
pedigree: Draw a pedigree tracing color blindness through three generations. Is this trait autosomal recessive or X-linked? Squares and circles across generation rows with mating lines, shaded affected individuals, and carrier dots.
bohrmodel: Draw the Bohr model of sodium. Show the electron shells for chlorine. How many electrons are in each ring for oxygen? Nucleus with proton/neutron count ringed by concentric shells with electrons as evenly-spaced dots.
equationbalancer: Balance this chemical equation: H₂ + O₂ → H₂O. Is my reaction balanced? How do I balance propane combustion? Reactants → products with subscripted coefficients and a per-element atom-count tally confirming conservation.
vseprmolecule: What shape is the water molecule? Draw the 3-D geometry of NH₃. What's the bond angle in BF₃? Central atom with wedge-dash bonds, lone pairs shown as dot pairs, and the VSEPR shape name and ideal angle labeled.
unitcircle: Show 30° on the unit circle. What's the exact coordinate at π/4? Find sin and cos for 2π/3. The angle arc, terminal radius, reference right triangle, and exact (cos θ, sin θ) coordinate all computed from the angle.
solidfigure: Draw a 4×3×2 rectangular prism. Show faces, edges, and vertices of a triangular prism. What's the volume of this cone? 3-D solid in oblique projection with hidden-edge dashes and surface-area/volume callouts.
crosssection: Show the layers of the Earth. What are the ocean depth zones? Diagram the skin tissue layers. Stacked bands sized by thickness with leader labels and a depth axis — or concentric rings for a planetary interior.
pianokeys: Show the C major chord on a piano. Which keys are in the G major scale? What notes make up Dm7? A keyboard with the relevant keys lit in role colors, note labels, and the chord or scale name displayed.
fretboardmap: Show the C major scale across the whole guitar neck. Where are the pentatonic positions? Map all the G notes on a bass. Full-neck diagram with colored dots at each string/fret position and interval labels.
circleoffifths: Show me the circle of fifths. What's the relative minor of Eb major? Which keys have two sharps? All twelve major keys and relative minors as a wheel with key signatures on the rim and the selected key highlighted.
odontogram: Chart tooth #14 as crowned and #19 as needing a root canal. Which teeth have cavities? Show my dental treatment plan. Upper and lower arches with each tooth numbered and color-coded by status — caries, filling, crown, missing.
clockface: Show a clock at 3:45. What does quarter past two look like on an analog clock? Display elapsed time from 1:00 to 1:40. Analog dial with computed hand positions and an optional shaded elapsed-time arc.
moneytray: Show how to make $1.37 with coins. What's the total of 3 quarters and 2 dimes? How do you make change for a $5 bill? Coin circles and bill rectangles in stacks with counts, a running total, and fewest-coins change.
placevaluechart: Show 347 in a place value chart. Break 2,465 into thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones. What's the expanded form of 58? Labeled columns per place with the digit, base-ten block glyphs, and expanded form written out.
shapecard: What are the properties of a hexagon? How many faces does a triangular prism have? Teach me the 2-D shapes. Clean shape illustrations with side, vertex, face, and edge count callouts and a real-world example.
letterform: Show me how to write the letter A. What's the stroke order for uppercase B? How do I form a lowercase g? Large letter on baseline/midline guidelines with numbered stroke order and a faint ghost to trace.
toolscale: How do I read a ruler at 3¾ inches? What does 65° look like on a protractor? Show 37.5°C on a thermometer. The instrument face with every tick computed and the indicator placed at the given value.
craftchart: Make a cross-stitch pattern of a heart. Show me a knitting chart for this row pattern. Create a pixel-art grid for a star. A stitch-by-stitch grid with colored or symbol-filled cells, numbered rulers, and a color legend.
slopegraph: How did rankings shift before vs after the change? Who gained or lost the most from 2019 to 2023? Before-and-after comparison showing each category's trajectory between two points.
dumbbell: What's the salary range for each job title? Show the gap between min and max across cities. Compare starting vs current pay by department — range or interval per group with a connector.
lollipop: Rank these countries by GDP per capita. Which products sold the most units? Top programming languages by popularity — a clean ranked list of values, cleaner than bars.
bulletchart: Are we on track to hit our sales quota? How does each team's revenue compare to target? Is our API latency within the SLA? Actual-vs-target with qualitative performance bands.
candlestick: Show me Apple's stock price this month. What did Bitcoin do last week — open, high, low, close per day? OHLC price chart for stocks, crypto, or any traded commodity over time.
gantt: Build a project timeline with start and end dates for each task. Show our Q3 roadmap with overlapping tasks and dependencies. Which work streams run in parallel during the product launch?
bubble: Plot countries by GDP, life expectancy, and population size together. Compare companies on revenue, growth rate, and headcount. Show three or four variables at once in one chart.
arearange: Show the revenue forecast with the uncertainty band. Plot temperature projections with confidence intervals. How wide is the prediction range for this model — trend line with a shaded range over time.
waffle: What share of users are on mobile vs desktop? 1 in 4 Americans do X — show that visually. Market share at a glance as a grid of squares — composition breakdown in 100 cells.
groupedbars: Compare Q1, Q2, Q3 sales side by side for each region. Show men vs women scores across age groups. How did each country perform across all metrics — multiple series clustered per category.
bridge: Why did profit drop this quarter? What drove the revenue change from last year to this year? Break down each factor behind the cost increase — waterfall from a starting value to the final total.
calheat: Show my commit history as a GitHub heatmap. How consistent is my workout streak over the past year? Visualize daily activity counts across weeks — streaks and gaps at a glance.
bump: How have app store rankings shifted month by month? Which teams moved up or down in standings over the season? Show rank changes over time so you can see who overtook whom.
marimekko: Show both the size of each regional market AND the product mix within it. Compare segment share when the segments themselves differ in total size — magnitude and composition together in one mosaic.
plot: Plot y = sin(x) and cos(x) on the same graph. Graph this quadratic. Show the curve for f(x) = x² − 3x + 2. Cartesian x/y plot of any mathematical function or equation with gridlines.
dualaxis: Plot revenue and profit margin together — they're on different scales. Show website traffic and conversion rate over the same months. Two metrics with different units sharing one time axis.
scatterregression: Is there a correlation between hours studied and test scores? Does ad spend predict sales? Show the trend line and R² for this dataset — scatter plot with OLS regression fit and residuals.
dotplot: Plot these 20 values as a dot chart. Show the distribution of my class's test scores, one dot per student. Where are the clusters and outliers in this small dataset — each observation as its own dot.
controlchart: Is our defect rate within control limits? Which data points are out of control? Show a Shewhart control chart for this process — UCL, LCL, center line, and flagged violations over time.
areaplot: Show the area under this curve between x=0 and x=4. Visualize the integral of f(x). What is consumer surplus on this demand curve? Shaded area-under-the-curve with optional Riemann rectangles.
supplydemand: Draw a supply and demand diagram. What happens to equilibrium when supply shifts right? Show how a price ceiling creates a shortage — upward supply + downward demand with P* and Q* marked.
bigo: How do different Big-O complexities compare as n grows? Why is O(n²) so much worse than O(n log n)? Chart all the canonical growth curves — O(1) through O(2^n) — so the exponential blowup is visible.
errorbars: Show the mean and confidence interval for each experimental group. Are these group differences meaningful? Report lab results with error bars — means with CI whiskers so overlap and uncertainty are clear.
eratimeline: What was happening in Europe vs Asia during the Renaissance? Show Roman and Chinese dynasties on the same timeline. Compare parallel eras across civilizations side by side — multi-track with era spans and shared time axis.
payoffdiagram: Show the payoff for a covered call at expiration. What's my P&L if I buy a straddle? Draw the profit and loss curve for this put option — options strategy payoff diagram with breakevens marked.
phasediagram: Draw a phase diagram for water. At what pressure does CO₂ become supercritical? Show where the triple point is and when sublimation happens — pressure vs temperature with solid/liquid/gas regions.
indifferencecurve: Draw indifference curves with a budget constraint. Show the optimal consumption bundle. How does utility theory explain consumer choice — MRS equals price ratio, tangency point on the highest reachable curve.
breakeven: How many units do we need to sell to break even? Show where revenue crosses total cost. At what volume does the business become profitable — CVP chart with fixed costs, variable costs, and the break-even point.
loaddiagram: Draw the shear force and bending moment diagrams for this beam. Show V(x) and M(x) for a simply supported beam with a point load — three stacked panels: loads, shear, and moment on one shared axis.
ecgstrip: Show me what a normal sinus rhythm looks like. Draw an ECG strip at 72 bpm. What does a PVC look like on the rhythm strip? ECG/EKG waveform on the classic clinical graticule with interval markers.
vitalstrip: Show all of a patient's vitals on one screen. Display HR, blood pressure, and SpO₂ trends with normal ranges highlighted. Which readings are out of range? Multi-channel bedside monitor with flagged abnormals.
growthcurve: Is my child's height on track for their age? Plot my son's measurements against the WHO percentile curves. At what percentile is a 3-year-old who is 36 inches — pediatric growth chart with p3–p97 bands.
sleepcycle: Show my sleep stages from last night. How many REM cycles did I get? Visualize the sleep architecture across the night — awake, REM, light, and deep as a stepped hypnogram with cycle count.
seasonband: What vegetables are in season each month? Show the planting and harvest windows for these crops. When do these flowers bloom — seasonal availability calendar across all 12 months with an optional 'now' marker.
callout: Important note to flag. Watch out for this. Pro tip worth highlighting. A tone-accented aside — warning, info, or tip — with optional collapsible detail.
verdictcard: Should I do X? Yes or no — give me your honest verdict. Is this a good idea or not? A clear yes/no/maybe stance with the one-line call, reason, and honest caveat.
scenarioset: Best case vs worst case — what are the possible outcomes? What could go right or wrong here? Optimistic, realistic, and pessimistic outcome panels without faking one precise number.
worthit: Is X worth buying? Worth the money for ME specifically? Should I upgrade? A personal worth-it / skip / depends verdict with fit splits, deal-breaker, and who it's really for.
companionnote: I'm really struggling right now. I just needed to say this. A warm one-line reflection that mirrors how you're feeling — no advice, no metrics, just being heard.
positioncard: Is this normal? How worried should I be? Should I see a doctor about this symptom? Places a situation on a low→high scale with an honest read and concrete escalation triggers.
differential: What could be causing this? Why is my X doing Y? Ranks plausible explanations by likelihood with tell-tale signs, what points elsewhere, and a can't-miss serious flag.
reframecard: I keep telling myself I'm not good enough. Help me challenge this thought. Shows the stuck belief verbatim, names the distortion, then offers a warmer, truer counter-thought.
breathpacer: I need to calm down right now. Walk me through a breathing exercise. Guide me through box breathing / 4-7-8. An animated orb pacing you through inhale, hold, and exhale.
copingmenu: I'm overwhelmed — what can I actually do right now? Give me coping options that match my energy level. Doable-right-now actions tagged by effort and time, no pressure to do all.
subtextdecode: What did they mean by this text? Is this passive aggressive? Is this a scam? Pins the message, ranks likely interpretations with textual cues, and suggests a clarifying reply.
rehearsal: How do I bring this up? What if they get defensive or angry? Help me prepare for a hard conversation. An opener, likely reactions as branches, coached replies, and a graceful exit.
messagescriptset: Write what I should say to cancel / dispute / ask X across multiple places at once. A ready-to-send card per target with the exact copy and a pushback rebuttal if needed.
talktrack: Write me a wedding toast / pitch / phone script I can read aloud. What do I literally say? Word-for-word spoken lines in order, each with a calm delivery beat beside it.
lifeline: I'm in crisis and need real help right now. I don't want to be here anymore. I'm being abused. Real verified region-appropriate helplines made tappable, with a warm opener.
proscons: Pros and cons of X. What are the upsides and downsides? Advantages vs disadvantages of this choice. Two weighted columns with an optional verdict tally to help weigh a decision.
takeaways: Key takeaways from this. What are the main points to remember? Summarize what matters most. Numbered highlights you can mark done as you go through them.
faq: FAQ about X. What are the most common questions people have about this? Answer the top questions on this topic — each expandable so I can read the ones I care about.
tabs: Organize this into tabs I can switch between — Overview, Details, Examples. Show these sections as labeled panels with icons and count badges I can navigate.
divider: Add a section header here. Break this into named sections I can jump between. A heading with optional eyebrow, count badge, and quick-jump chips to navigate the content.
pullquote: Pull out the best quote from this. What did they actually say? The most memorable line from this speech or interview — large, attributed, with a tone accent bar.
storystrip: Tell this story as a sequence of panels. Walk me through this event by event like a comic strip. A narrative you advance step by step with a stepper control.
casestudy: Walk me through a case study of X. How did Y company do Z — setup, what they did, the result, and the lesson. An expandable setup→action→result→lesson breakdown.
deflist: Glossary of X terms. Define all these words for me. Key terms with definitions — searchable so I can quickly find the meaning I'm looking for.
accordion: Organize this into collapsible sections I can expand one at a time. Show these topics so I can open only what I need. Expandable sections that hide detail until clicked.
scansionmark: Scan this poem — mark the stressed and unstressed syllables. Is this iambic pentameter? What's the meter and rhyme scheme? Stress marks per syllable with foot bars in the margin.
typespec: Show me the type scale / typography spec. Heading, body, caption — what size, weight, and typeface? Each role rendered at its real size with spec chips and font-pairing showcase.
shotlist: Shot list for this scene. What shots do I need for this video? A per-shot breakdown with framing, lens, movement, duration, and the action and dialogue line for each.
beatsheet: Beat sheet for this screenplay / story. What are the narrative beats and where do they fall? Structure mapped with name, position, and a one-liner under an optional tension curve.
promptset: Give me journaling prompts for tonight. What should I reflect on? Evening wind-down questions, gratitude prompts, morning check-in — open questions to think with, not a checklist.
zoneladder: What are the heart rate training zones? Zone 2 explained. What's my target HR for fat burn vs cardio vs VO2 max? Stacked intensity bands from easy to hardest, each with range and purpose.
picturesequence: Show the steps in order for kids / beginners. First, then, next, last — how do you do X? A left-to-right illustrated panel strip with step markers and captions between each stage.
beforeafter: Show me before and after the renovation. What did it look like before the edit? How did this landscape change after the storm? Side-by-side real photo pair with a draggable wipe revealing both images.
carousel: Show me photos of these dishes. Give me a slideshow of the results. Swipe through product shots — a tap-through gallery of real images with captions, advancing one slide at a time.
imagecallouts: Label the parts in this photo. What is each component in this image? Annotate what I'm looking at — hotspot pins on a real photo that reveal names and details on tap.
waveform: Show me the audio waveform. Visualize this sound wave over time. Mark the key moments in this recording — an interactive audio timeline with bar amplitudes and a scrubber.
videoembed: Embed this video with chapters. Show me this YouTube link with section navigation — a video player where I can jump straight to each chapter from a list.
geomap: Show these places on a map. Where is X located? Put these spots on an interactive map — real pins with lat/lng, popups with names, on live OpenStreetMap tiles.
lightbox: Show me a photo gallery. Display these images in a grid I can browse. Let me click to see them full screen — a tappable image collection with an expand-to-full lightbox.
moodboard: Create a moodboard for this project. What visual direction should we go? Capture the aesthetic — a masonry collage of images, color swatches, and mood words.
palette: Show me a color palette for my brand. What are the hex codes? Check my colors for accessibility — swatches with hex values and WCAG contrast pass/fail verdicts.
mediacard: What should I watch tonight? Recommend one film or book for me — a poster-forward card with cover art, score badge, runtime, spoiler-safe logline, genre tags, and where to stream.
diagram: Draw a diagram of how this works. Label the anatomy of X. Show me a schematic of this circuit — a labeled vector figure with shapes, lines, polygons, and annotated callouts.
svgblock: Draw me a molecule. Illustrate this geometric figure. Create a custom visual no standard chart covers — a bespoke hand-drawn SVG for one-of-a-kind infographics and unique shapes.
sportspitch: Show the team formation. Draw the defensive play. Where should players line up on the pitch? A real field or court with position markers, player labels, and tactical play arrows.
floorplan: Draw a floor plan of this apartment. Show me the office layout. How would these rooms be arranged? — a top-down labeled room plan with each space as a named rectangle.
dimensiondrawing: Create a technical drawing for this part. Give me a dimensioned shop drawing with tolerances — a to-scale profile with extension lines, arrowheads, measurements, and a title block.
explodedview: Show me how this assembly comes apart. Give me an exploded view with part numbers. How do these components fit together? — separated parts with numbered balloon callouts and a parts list.
weldsymbol: Show me the AWS weld symbol for this joint. Explain this welding callout. What does the weld spec mean? — joint cross-section plus a reference-line symbol with a full legend.
cutlist: Give me a cut list for this woodworking project. How do I nest these pieces on the sheet to minimize waste? — a parts table with a to-scale nesting layout and computed yield %.
spacefit: Will this sofa fit in my living room? Help me plan the furniture layout — a room drawn to scale with furniture placed inside, walkway clearances labeled and flagged when tight.
anatomyfigure: Label the parts of the heart. Show me the anatomy of the knee. What are the structures inside this organ? — a built-in anatomy illustration with numbered callout pins and notes.
exposuretriangle: Explain the exposure triangle. How do aperture, shutter speed, and ISO relate? Help me understand camera settings — a triangle wiring the three controls with their depth/motion/noise trade-offs.
colorwheel: What colors go well with blue? Show me complementary colors. Give me a triadic color scheme — a hue ring with harmony geometry drawn from my base color, plus swatches and hex codes.
artanalysis: Analyze the composition of this painting. Show me the rule of thirds. What visual techniques are at work here? — a compositional overlay with focal regions, palette row, and technique notes.
mixerboard: Show me the track layout for this song. How are the instruments arranged in the mix? Give me a DAW-style view — stacked track lanes with clip blocks, volume bars, and pan indicators.
wireframe: Wireframe this page for me. Sketch out the UI before we build it. Show me a rough homepage layout — low-fidelity placeholder regions (header, hero, cards, CTA, footer) on a column grid.
maproute: Plot my hiking route on a map. Show this walking tour in order. Map out this road trip stop by stop — ordered waypoints as a polyline with a stop-by-stop itinerary and distance summary.
moonphase: What's the moon phase tonight? Is the moon waxing or waning? Show me the lunar phase for this date — a disk showing the lit terminator shape, phase name, and illumination percentage.
skychart: What's visible in the sky tonight? Show me a star chart. Which constellations are up right now? — a circular planisphere with stars, constellation connect-the-dots, and planet positions.
orbitdiagram: Show me the solar system layout. Diagram the orbits of these planets. How are Jupiter's moons arranged? — a central body with concentric orbit rings, scaled bodies, and period annotations.
gameboard: Show me this chess opening. Display the Go board position. What does the board look like after these moves? — a configured grid with pieces placed, highlighted squares, and move arrows.
patternpiece: Show me how to cut this fabric. Give me a sewing layout for this pattern. How much fabric do I need? — a to-scale fabric sheet with pattern pieces placed, grainline arrows, and yield %.
insight: What's our conversion rate? How many signups last month? What's total revenue this quarter? One big headline number with an optional period-over-period delta and confidence level.
chart: How has X trended over time? Plot revenue by month. Compare two metrics year-over-year. A line or area chart tracking one or more series across dates with optional axes.
breakdown: Where does our revenue come from? Break down traffic by source. How is the budget distributed? Categories with percentages, values, and heat indicators showing each share.
timeline: What happened when? Walk me through the history of X. Timeline of major events in order. Ordered steps or events with dates, tags, and color coding.
list: Give me a list of X. What are the top things to know? Tips for doing Y. Key points about Z. A clean bulleted rundown of items, tips, or takeaways with a title.
compare: Compare A vs B vs C. Which option is better for my use case? Help me choose between X and Y. Options scored against shared criteria side-by-side with a recommended pick.
ring: How complete are my goals across categories? Show health across multiple metrics. Progress on these projects at once. Concentric rings tracking completion or status per metric.
bars: Show sales by region. Compare revenue by month. Which category performs best? Rank these by value. Vertical bars per category with an optional goal line and heat coloring.
stack: How is our budget composed? Show time allocation as a stacked bar. Part-of-whole across categories. A horizontal bar split into labeled colored segments with totals.
scatter: Is there a correlation between X and Y? Does marketing spend relate to revenue? Show the relationship between these two variables. An X/Y point cloud with an optional trend line.
heat: Show activity by day and hour. Which day/time combination is busiest? Heat map of X by Y. A color-scaled grid revealing intensity across two categorical axes with row/column headers.
flow: How does X work step by step? Walk me through the process from start to finish. What are the stages of this pipeline? Sequential steps with subtitles and color coding.
web: Search the web for X. What are the top results for Y? Find sources on this topic. Web search results with titles, domains, and excerpts — optionally refreshable.
gallery: Show me photos of X. Display these images in a grid. Visual gallery of Y. A grid of images with per-image captions, category tags, and optional section headers.
codemap: Map out the code architecture. What modules depend on this one? How do these components connect? A central concept with radiating code nodes, dependency notes, and heat.
diff: What changed in this code? Show the diff between these two versions. Which lines were added or removed? Code diff with highlighted additions, deletions, and line counts.
checks: Did the tests pass? What checks failed? Show validation results. Test or validation items each marked pass/fail/skip with explanatory notes.
donut: Show market share as a pie chart. What percentage is each category? Donut chart of budget allocation. A circular chart split into colored wedges with percentages and labels.
gauge: What's our NPS score? How ready are we for launch? Show this health percentage on a dial. A radial gauge showing score, readiness, or progress with optional driver text.
scoreboard: What's the score? Who won last night? Final result for Lakers vs Celtics. Away and home team scores with game clock, live or final status, and heat highlighting.
standings: Who's in first place? Show the current league standings. What's the playoff picture? A ranked table with team, win/loss record, streak, and games-behind per division.
pipeline: Show the sales pipeline. How many deals are in each stage? What's our funnel breakdown right now? Deal stages with volumes, optional conversion metrics, and totals.
kpi: Show me the key metrics. Give me a stats dashboard at a glance. What are the most important numbers? A grid of labeled metric cards with values and optional trend indicators.
quotes: What are customers saying? Show testimonials. Pull up user feedback with attribution. Attributed quotes with tone indicators, ideal for reviews or social proof.
checklist: What's done and what's still to do? Give me a task checklist. Show progress on these items. A checklist with done/doing/todo status per item.
understand: What do you understand about my situation so far? What assumptions are you making? Summarize what you know about me. Cited learning points with confidence levels I can correct.
schema: Draw the database schema. Show an ER diagram. How do these tables connect? Entities with fields, types, and labeled relationship arrows — a full data model at a glance.
screenmap: What screens does this app need? Show wireframe thumbnails for each view. Map out the product UI. Thumbnail wireframes for dashboard, table, detail, and other key screens.
buildprog: Walk me through building X. Show the creation steps with progress status. What's been done, what's next? Ordered build steps each with a status badge and subtitle.
preview: Build me a working app for X. Create a live interactive demo. Generate a clickable prototype. A mini-app with dashboard, table, board, and activity views you can click through.
allocatepeople: Divide the chores between us. Split tasks among our team. Who's doing what for the group project? Assigns named people their tasks with a load bar so an uneven split is immediately obvious.
forecast: What's the weather this week? Will it rain on Saturday? 5-day forecast for Chicago. Multi-day grid with daily high/low, condition icons, and precipitation chance per day.
agenda: Plan my day. What's the meeting agenda? Give me an itinerary for my Paris trip. Time-ordered schedule with locations, durations, and notes for each item.
picks: Best books on investing. Top 5 espresso machines under $200. Recommend me some history podcasts. Ranked picks with a reason, price, rating, and badge for each.
timezones: What time is it in Tokyo right now? Best overlap to call my team across London, NYC, and Sydney. Local times shown side-by-side with UTC offsets and home timezone highlighted.
transitroute: How do I get from downtown to JFK by subway? Directions to the airport by bus. Step-by-step transit or driving route with mode icons, line names, and total travel time.
amortization: How much of my mortgage is interest vs principal each month? Show me the payoff schedule for a $400k loan at 6.5%. Per-period breakdown with a running balance that pays down to zero.
receipt: Show me an itemized bill for my order. Break down the costs of my shopping cart. Receipt for our dinner. Line items with quantities and prices, subtotal, tax, and grand total.
settleup: Split the Airbnb cost among four of us. We all paid different amounts — who owes whom? After the trip, who needs to pay back what? Shows who paid what and minimum transfers to settle up.
bracketbar: Rank the top 10 streaming platforms. Most popular programming languages this year. Poll results from highest to lowest. Numbered bars with scores for each ranked item.
recipecard: How do I make chicken tikka masala? Recipe for banana bread. What's a good carbonara? Ingredients with quantities, numbered cooking steps, and pro tips.
workoutplan: Give me a 3-day gym plan to build muscle. Beginner workout routine for losing weight. Create a 4-week training program. Sessions with exercises, sets, reps, and rest periods.
medicationschedule: When should I take all my medications? Dosing schedule for my post-surgery prescriptions. Drug names, doses, and timing instructions laid out through the day.
macrobreakdown: How many calories and macros in a chicken breast? What are the macros for my meal? Calorie headline with a protein/carbs/fat/fiber split and optional per-item breakdown.
plangrid: Make me a weekly meal plan. 7-day study schedule for finals week. Daily habit tracker for the month. A grid of days and slots showing what goes where, free slots left blank.
budgetallocator: Help me budget my $5k monthly salary. How should I allocate my income? Zero-based budget for our household. Income at top, category bars, and a live 'left to allocate' meter.
howtosteps: How do I change a tire? Steps to install a ceiling fan. How to patch drywall yourself. Numbered steps with prep time, tools needed, cautions, and a tip per step.
livecompute: What would my monthly mortgage payment be at 7%? How long will my startup runway last? Drag sliders and one projected number updates live from a transparent arithmetic formula.
countdown: How many days until my vacation? Countdown to the project deadline. Days left until the wedding. Live ticking clock showing days/hours/minutes/seconds remaining to a real date.
livescore: Keep score for game night. Scoreboard for our trivia tournament. Track points across teams. Tap +/- per player and the standings recompute live with the leader highlighted.
nutritionlabel: Show me the nutrition label for almond milk. What's the %DV for this cereal? Nutrition facts for canned black beans. FDA-style panel with serving size, calories, and %DV rows.
unitconvert: How many cups is 500ml? Convert 180°F to Celsius. How many tablespoons in a quarter cup? Aligned equivalencies showing the from-amount next to every matching unit by category.
packlist: What should I pack for a week in Europe in November? Packing list for a camping trip. What to bring for a beach holiday. Grouped by category with a packed-vs-total progress meter.
pregnancyweek: What's happening at 20 weeks pregnant? How big is the baby at 28 weeks? Milestones for week 16. Week card with a fruit-size comparison, length/weight, and what to expect this week.
cycletrack: When am I most fertile this cycle? Show my ovulation window. Period calendar for a 28-day cycle. Day-by-day band marking period days, fertile window, ovulation, and today.
contractiontimer: Are my contractions getting closer together? Is it time to go to the hospital? How frequent and long are my contractions? Bar strip of logged contractions with average interval and frequency readout.
prayertimes: What time is Fajr today in Dubai? Show me today's salah schedule for my city. Named prayer slots plotted on a sun arc, with the next prayer highlighted and a countdown.
datatable: Show me this as a table I can sort and filter. Display these results in rows and columns, let me search through them — a sortable, filterable, searchable data view.
pivot: Break down sales by region AND product category at once. How does X vary across two dimensions? Crosstab or pivot table — color-scaled cells with row/col totals.
leaderboard: Who's winning? Rank these by score with medals and movement arrows. Show me standings, top-10 lists, or league rankings with bars and up/down delta indicators.
treetable: Show budget by department with expandable sub-teams. Drill into this hierarchy as a table — collapsible rows, nested subcategories, inline bars, and tags.
swimlane: How does a request flow between frontend, API, and database? Map multi-team handoffs over time — UML sequence diagram, checkout flow, who does what in each actor's lane.
footnotetable: Show me this data with hover-to-read citations. I need a table with clickable footnotes for each fact — academic-style numbered references anchored to cells.
sparktable: Show each metric with its trend inline. Table of KPIs with a mini sparkline per row — current value, delta, and recent movement all visible at a glance.
smallmultiples: Show the trend for every country on one screen. Compare all categories at once in small panels — same scale, one mini chart per group, side-by-side trellis view.
comparebars: Compare these options across multiple metrics side by side. How do X, Y, Z stack up on speed, cost, quality — horizontal bar rows per metric, highlight one series to dim others.
comparematrix: Compare these schools of thought, systems, or options side by side. How do capitalism, socialism, and communism differ across ownership, prices, and goals? Stoicism vs Buddhism vs Existentialism — a qualitative comparison grid with a short value, a yes/no/partial verdict, or a 0–5 rating per cell, flagging the winner of each attribute.
matrixgrid: Heatmap this, show the correlation matrix, or display my model's confusion matrix — a color-scaled numeric grid so I can spot patterns, clusters, and outliers at a glance.
clearancematrix: Can I take these supplements together? Which drug or ingredient combinations are safe vs dangerous? Compatibility check — give each pair a safe/caution/avoid verdict with the reason.
matrix: Write out this matrix, truth table, or Punnett square. Show linear algebra values in a labeled grid — multiplication table, logic combinations, genetics crosses, or system of equations.
eligibilitycheck: Do I qualify for this grant, loan, or program? Am I eligible for X? Check my situation against the requirements — each rule weighed against my real facts with a clear qualify / not-yet / depends verdict.
evidencetrace: How do you know that? Show me the actual records behind this claim. What data proves this number? Lists raw underlying evidence verbatim — each item with its source, timestamp, and provenance count.
reviewsynth: What do reviews say about X? Is it worth buying? What are customers complaining about? Synthesizes many real reviews into a star distribution, love/complaint themes with verbatim quotes, and the main dealbreaker.
annotateddoc: Annotate this document. Add margin notes explaining key passages. Highlight the important parts and comment on them. Prose with highlighted sections and hover/click margin commentary revealing the notes.
redline: Redline this document. Show me what changed. Track edits between these two drafts. Displays tracked, final, and original copy — added text and removals clearly marked, switchable via tabs.
citationchain: Trace this claim back to its source. Show the chain of evidence. Where does this really come from? Expandable tree from claim to source to underlying evidence, each link rated by strength.
factcheck: Is this true? Fact-check these claims. Which parts are accurate, misleading, or false? Each claim gets a verdict, confidence score, and expandable source detail you can drill into.
confidencemeter: How confident are you in this? How certain is this answer? Break down your certainty by factor. Segmented confidence meter showing what supports and limits the answer, with hover detail per segment.
highlightsnippet: Show me the exact quote. What does the source actually say? Pull out the key sentence. A verbatim excerpt with the critical phrase highlighted and a toggle to reveal the full surrounding context.
annotcallouts: Label the parts of this diagram. Explain each section of this schematic. Add callout pins to this layout. Numbered pins on a surface or image — click each pin to read its label and detail.
sourcelist: What are the best sources on this? List your references. Where can I read more? Ranked links sorted by relevance, each expandable to show a snippet preview of what that source says.
claimgrid: Which evidence supports or contradicts each claim? Map these studies to these claims. Which sources back which points? A claim × evidence grid — each cell marks support, contradiction, or partial match.
docoutline: Give me a table of contents. Outline this document. What are the main sections and subsections? Collapsible heading hierarchy with jump links and a progress indicator as you read through.
docview: Show me this document. Let me read this. Focus on a specific passage while the rest dims. A page-style document viewer with spotlight mode to highlight one section and dim everything else.
pdfreader: Open this PDF. Let me scroll through this report. Browse this multi-page file. A scrollable page-by-page reader with a live page counter so you can navigate the full document at your own pace.
diffviewer: What changed between these two versions? Show me the diff. Compare these files side by side. Added lines in green, removed in red, unchanged context in grey — inline or split view.
clinicaltimeline: Show my medical history as a timeline. When did each symptom, diagnosis, and treatment happen? Lay out my care journey in order — chronological health events with tests, results, and status.
researchsummary: What does the research say about X? Summarize this study. What are the key findings and limitations? Structured breakdown of question, method, results, conclusion, and caveats for a paper or study.
paralleltext: Show the original and translation side by side. Align these texts line by line. Compare two versions in parallel — synchronized columns with per-line notes and divergence highlights.
treemap: Break down our budget/codebase/market-share by category and subcategory. Where does it all go? Shows nested proportional rectangles so you can see part-to-whole at every level.
sunburst: Show me the hierarchy from kingdom to species, top-level org to teams, or taxonomy from broad to narrow. Radial rings expand outward so you can see how the whole splits into nested parts.
sankey: How does energy/money/traffic flow from source to destination? Where does it split and where does it go — budget allocation, energy transfer, user paths through pages.
network: How are these things connected to each other? Map the relationships — social graph, service dependencies, linked concepts, who references whom, what talks to what.
radar: Compare these two phones/candidates/strategies across all the criteria at once — show strengths and gaps. Rate each option on the same dimensions and see who wins where.
waterfall: Walk me through how revenue/cost/profit went from X to Y — what added and what subtracted. Show each contributor as a stepping bridge from the start value to the final total.
funnel: Show conversion drop-off through each stage — signups to trials to paid, leads to closed deals, visitors to buyers. How many make it all the way through and where do we lose people?
histogram: What's the distribution of test scores/salaries/response times? How many fall in each range? Show frequency across bins so I can see the spread, skew, and where the bulk lands.
boxplot: Compare the spread and median across groups — salaries by department, scores by school, latency by region. Show quartiles, outliers, and skew side-by-side per category.
streamgraph: How has our product mix/genre popularity/topic share shifted over time? Show flowing stacked bands so I can see what's rising, peaking, and fading across months or years.
venn: What do these two groups have in common vs what's unique to each? Show the overlap — shared features, mutual customers, intersecting skills — and what belongs only to one side.
diagramflow: How does this process work? Draw the feedback loop. Map how A leads to B. Show me how these concepts connect. Freeform node-and-edge diagram for any process, concept map, or system.
composite: Show me the trend AND the breakdown side by side. I want a chart plus a summary table in one view. Nothing single fits — combine two views. Lays out multiple block types together in one panel.
sequencediagram: What happens when I call the login API — which services talk in order? Diagram the request flow. How does OAuth work? UML sequence for actor message-passing over time.
statemachine: What states does an order go through? Show all transitions for a checkout flow. Draw a state machine for a traffic light or door lock. Visualizes discrete states and the triggers that move between them.
erdiagram: What should my database schema look like? Show how Users, Orders, and Products relate. ER diagram for a blog or e-commerce app. Shows tables with fields and foreign-key cardinality lines.
circuitdiagram: Draw a basic RC circuit. Show a low-pass filter schematic. How does current flow in a series or parallel circuit? Renders a wired schematic with resistors, capacitors, and voltage sources.
argumentmap: Analyze this argument — what are the premises and objections? Map out the debate on X. Show the support and weaknesses of this claim. Renders a central thesis with supporting premises and objections branching off it.
probabilitytree: What's the probability of getting two heads in three flips? Walk through conditional probability. Genetics Punnett cross. Branches each outcome with its probability and multiplies down to final leaves.
datastructure: Show me how a BST works. What does a linked list look like? Visualize a stack, queue, or heap. Draws CS data structures with real cells, pointers, and tree layouts for algorithm walkthroughs.
causationchain: What caused World War 1? Show causes and effects of the French Revolution. Root-cause analysis — why did this system fail? Left-to-right: causes into a central event, consequences branching right.
protocolstack: Explain the OSI model. How does TCP/IP work? What happens to a packet at each network layer? Where does HTTP live? Shows the layer stack beside a packet encapsulation view.
wiringdiagram: How do I wire a 3-way switch? Show a GFCI outlet wiring diagram. What does a service panel one-line look like? Draws residential wiring with trade symbols and color-coded hot/neutral/ground conductors.
pipingschematic: Show a hot water heating loop schematic. How does a pool pump-and-filter circuit work? Draw a basic HVAC closed loop. Renders process glyphs — tanks, pumps, valves — with routed flow lines.
logicgates: How does an AND gate work? Build a half-adder from gates. Show the truth table for XOR. Draw a NAND-only circuit. Shows wired gate symbols with live 0/1 signal values and an optional truth table.
algorithmtrace: Trace bubble sort on this array step by step. Walk me through binary search. Visualize quicksort partitioning. Steps through an algorithm over an array with colored cells and labeled pointer carets.
cyclewheel: Explain the water cycle. Stages of the carbon or rock cycle. Draw the product development loop. Life cycle of a butterfly or cell. Shows 3-8 labeled stages with icons in a closed ring and flowing arrows.
a11yaudit: Is my page accessible? What are the a11y issues? Does this pass WCAG? Accessibility check results with each criterion marked pass, warn, or fail plus an overall score.
progressbar: How far along is the project? What stage are we at in the process? Where do we stand in the workflow? Milestones with visual progress through each stage.
stepindicator: What step am I on? Show me which steps are complete and what's next. Walk me through these setup or onboarding stages. Ordered steps with done, active, and locked states.
statustimeline: What happened and when? Give me a log of events with timestamps. Timeline of incidents or state changes. Time-ordered events each labeled with a filterable status badge.
healthgrid: Is everything up? Which services are down? Give me a system status overview. Grid of services or endpoints each showing ok, warning, or down with hover details.
emptystate: Design an empty state. What should I show when there's no data yet? First-time user placeholder screen. Illustrated headline, supporting copy, and optional call-to-action.
skeleton: Show a loading placeholder while content fetches. Design a skeleton loader. What to display while data loads. Shimmer-animated placeholder that previews the content shape.
sliderinput: Let me adjust a setting with a slider. Budget knob. How many nights or units? Drag-to-set control with a live value display and optional derived calculation.
segmented: Toggle between a few options. Switch views: day, week, or month. Mode selector or category picker. Animated control where exactly one option is active at a time.
rangefilter: Filter by price range. Show items between $X and $Y. Narrow results by age or size. Dual-handle slider that live-filters a list and updates the matching count.
ratinginput: Rate this out of 5 stars. How would you score it? Leave a review rating. Tappable star or heart control with optional breakdown by facets like quality, service, and value.
painscale: Rate your pain on a scale of 0 to 10. How bad is it? Wong-Baker faces pain rating. Clinical visual-analog scale for pain assessment and symptom tracking.
habittracker: Track my habits this week. Did I hit my goals? Which days did I exercise, meditate, or study? Weekly grid of habits with daily completion and per-habit progress rings.
streakgrid: How long is my streak? Don't break the chain. Show my current vs best run. Recent-day dots with current and best streak counters to keep consistency momentum.
trustmap: Who can actually see my data? Where is my info stored, what's shared with third parties? Maps data types to storage locations and viewers with an honest security checklist.
kanban: Show me the task board. What's in progress vs done? Organize my work into columns. A multi-stage board with cards, assignees, and tags so you see workflow status at a glance.
wizard: Walk me through this. Step-by-step guide for setting up X. How do I get started? A guided flow with numbered steps, progress indicators, and status so nothing gets skipped.
decisiontree: Help me decide. Should I do X or Y — show me the if-then logic. Decision flowchart for troubleshooting. A branching yes/no tree that walks through questions to concrete outcomes.
goaltree: Show me the OKRs. Break down objectives into key results with progress. What's the goal hierarchy? An OKR tree linking objectives to key results with completion tracking per level.
plandag: What depends on what? Which tasks block others — show me the dependency graph. A directed task graph with prerequisite edges that reveals the critical path before you start.
milestones: What are the key milestones? When do we hit each phase? A chronological milestone list with dates, owners, and done/on-track/at-risk status for the whole project.
processflow: How does this work, step by step? Walk me through the process. What's the procedure for X? A linear step-by-step flow with branching notes and detail callouts per stage.
journeymap: Map the customer journey. What does a user feel at each stage — where are the pain points and touchpoints? Shows an end-to-end experience with emotions, actions, and friction moments.
orgchart: Who reports to whom? Show me the company structure. What does the team hierarchy look like? A recursive org chart with parent-child reporting lines across the whole organization.
roadmap: What's the product roadmap? What's planned for Q1–Q4 and when does each feature ship? A multi-lane quarterly roadmap with item spans and delivery status across teams.
chronologicaltimeline: Give me a timeline of events. What happened when, in order? History of X chronologically. A dated event timeline with icons, descriptions, and status for each entry.
skilltree: What should I learn next? Show me the progression path and prerequisites. What's the tech tree for X? A tiered skill tree with prerequisite edges, unlock costs, and locked/unlocked states.
sparkstat: What's our MRR right now and is it trending up? How many active users do we have today? A key number paired with its recent trend line so you can see direction at a glance.
counter: How many sign-ups did we get this month? What's the total order count? Show a milestone number big and bold, animated to count up, with a label and change delta.
herostat: What's the headline number for our board deck? Give me the one stat that tells the Q3 story with some context. A giant metric front-and-center with a narrative explanation and hoverable trend detail.
trendtile: Is our churn rate going up or down vs last month? How much did DAUs shift week over week? A metric tile with its direction arrow, percent change, and a mini spark bar — the compact moving-number card.
scorebadge: What's my credit score as a letter grade? How does our domain authority rate out of 100 — A, B, or C? A circular graded badge for any 0–100 quality, health, or readiness score.
percentilebar: What percentile did I score on the SAT? Am I in the top 10% for salary in my field? How does my child's height rank for their age? Shows where a value falls on a distribution — 'you're in the top X%'.
statpair: What's our LTV-to-CAC ratio? How do revenue and cost compare as a multiple? Show me visitors vs signups with the conversion rate between them — two related numbers side by side with their computed ratio.
scorecard: Give me a snapshot of all our key metrics. What are the main health numbers for our app right now? A grid of mini metric tiles — icon, value, and trend arrow — for an at-a-glance multi-metric overview.
deltacascade: How did we go from last year's revenue to this year's — what changed? Walk me through every factor that added up to the final total. Shows a chain of +/– step changes flowing into a cumulative end value.
bulletkpi: Are we hitting our sales targets? Which KPIs are on track and which are missing quota? Show actual vs target for every metric — stacked rows each with a mini bar making the gap immediately visible.
confusionmatrix: How accurate is my spam classifier — show true vs false positives and negatives. What's the precision and recall for each class? Visualize actual vs predicted outcomes for a binary or multi-class model evaluation.
kpidashboard: Give me an executive dashboard of our SaaS metrics — MRR, churn, CAC, runway. What's the board-level view of our company health? A one-glance grid of KPI tiles each with a big number, delta, and sparkline.
blanks: What info should I add? I have a partial plan but need to fill in my deadline and budget. Here's what I know — what gaps remain? Prompts you to supply the personal values only you can give, highlighted as fillable fields.
buttonbar: Show me button variants. What do primary, secondary, and destructive states look like? How should interactive buttons appear in my design system? A gallery of button styles with ripple effects and live state tracking.
textfield: Show me a text input with validation. What does an email field with an error state look like? How should a form's single-line inputs appear? Labeled input fields with validation states and helper text.
textarea: Show me a multi-line text box. How does an auto-growing comment or notes field look with a character limit? An expanding text area with a live character counter.
select: How does a dropdown picker look? Show me a single-select field. What should a category or country selector look like in a form? A styled dropdown with optional icons and captions for choosing one option.
combobox: How does a search-and-pick field work? Show me a type-ahead autocomplete. What does a searchable dropdown with suggestions look like? Live-filtering combobox with metadata hints as you type.
checkboxgroup: Let me pick multiple options from a list. How do checkboxes look with a select-all toggle? Show me a multi-select form control. Checkboxes with an indeterminate select-all state and group label.
actionchecklist: Give me a 30-day plan I can tick off. What are my next steps this week? Build me an action checklist with priorities and due dates. Checkable action items you mark done as you go, tagged by priority and deadline.
radiogroup: Help me pick exactly one option from a list. Show me a radio button group. What should a single-choice selector with descriptions look like? Radio cards with icons, captions, and value badges.
switchset: Show me feature toggles I can flip on or off. What do settings controls look like? How should enable/disable options appear? Labeled rows of toggle switches, each with a description of what it does.
togglegroup: Show me a segmented button toggle. How do I switch between modes like grid vs list or left/center/right alignment? A compact button group for picking among mutually exclusive or combinable modes.
otp: How does a verification code input look? Show me a 2FA entry field — those individual digit boxes. What does an OTP form look like? Segmented passcode boxes with a verify action and resend option.
scalefelt: How big is the sun compared to Earth? How far is a light year? How heavy is a blue whale? Puts a raw number in human terms with relatable real-world analogies and a proportional cue.
hearit: How does this word actually sound out loud? Play me a perfect fifth interval. What does 440 Hz sound like? Tap-to-hear rows for spoken words, musical notes, and raw tones.
factsheet: Give me a fact sheet on Ada Lovelace. Key facts about Singapore. Quick overview of the Hubble Space Telescope — labeled key/value rows with an optional prose summary.
newsdigest: What's happening with the Ukraine conflict right now? Catch me up on AI headlines this week. What are the latest stories on climate policy? Timestamped headlines with sources and summaries.
dictionary: Define 'ephemeral'. What does 'sonder' mean? Etymology of 'serendipity' — full dictionary card with phonetics, numbered senses, example sentences, synonyms, and word history.
translation: Translate this paragraph into Spanish. What does this Japanese sentence mean? How do you say 'I love you' in Arabic? Full translation with language pair and optional sentence-by-sentence breakdown.
pronunciation: How do you say 'quinoa'? How is 'Worcestershire' pronounced? IPA breakdown of 'entrepreneur' — syllable split, IPA notation, and phoneme tips for getting the word right.
gloss: Glossary of machine learning terms. What do these legal abbreviations mean? Key vocabulary for this field — searchable domain glossary with definitions and cross-references.
ipachart: Show me the IPA vowel chart. Map out English vowel sounds. How is this consonant articulated? The vowel quadrilateral or pulmonic consonant grid with highlighted symbols and example words.
scriptstroke: Stroke order for 你好. How do I write this kanji? Show me how to write the Chinese character for 'love' — glyph on a practice grid with numbered strokes, romanization, and meaning.
phonicsword: How do you sound out 'through'? Break 'knight' into phonemes for my kid. Help decode this word — grapheme-by-grapheme sound chunks, tap-to-hear audio, and a rhyming-words row.
speciescard: What bird is this? Help me identify this plant. Tell me about the red fox — field-guide card with photo, common and scientific name, ID field marks, habitat, range, and conservation status.
reasoning: Show me your reasoning. Walk me through how you got that answer. Think through this step by step. Renders the model's chain of thought as expandable numbered steps.
toolcalls: What tool calls did the agent make? Show me the function invocations and their responses. What did the AI call behind the scenes? Logs each tool request and its returned payload in sequence.
agenttrace: How did the agent decide what to do? Show the decision tree with scores. Why did it pick this action over others? Visualizes the agent's branching choices with confidence scores per branch.
modelcompare: GPT-4 vs Claude vs Gemini on this — which did better? Compare multiple LLM outputs on the same prompt. Side-by-side responses with diff highlights where the models diverge.
tokenstream: Show me token-by-token confidence. Which words was the model least sure about? What alternatives could have been sampled? A heatmap of each token's probability with top alternative tokens shown.
retrieval: What did the RAG system retrieve for this query? Show me the search results with relevance scores. How were the passages ranked? Ranked source chunks from the vector store with similarity scores.
whatchanged: What changed between these two versions? Show me a before-and-after diff. What was updated, added, or removed? A unified diff view highlighting every inserted and deleted line.
routing: Which route or model did the system pick for this query, and why? Show me the routing scores. How did the classifier decide? Each candidate branch with its score and the winning path highlighted.
embedmap: Visualize the embedding space. Show me how these documents cluster semantically. Plot the vector representations in 2D. A scatter plot of embeddings colored by cluster, revealing semantic groupings.
calibration: Is this model well-calibrated? Plot predicted vs actual probabilities. How reliable are the confidence scores? A calibration curve showing where the model is overconfident or underconfident.
httpexchange: Show me the HTTP request and response. What API calls were made and what did they return? Debug this REST exchange. Each request's method, URL, status code, latency, and body preview in sequence.
datepicker: Pick a date, choose a deadline, or set an appointment. Single-date calendar popover for scheduling, booking, or filtering by one specific date.
calendarpick: Show me this month's calendar. What days do I have events? See scheduled items with event dots on a browsable inline monthly calendar view.
daterange: Book from April 5 to April 12, filter results by a date range, or pick trip start and end dates. Two-month calendar to choose a from/to window.
timepicker: What time should this start? Pick a meeting time, set an alarm for 7:30 AM, or choose a delivery window. Hour/minute stepper with AM/PM toggle.
colorpicker: Pick a color for my design, choose a hex code, or select a brand accent color. Swatch grid and hue bar to choose any color with a live hex preview.
fileupload: Upload a file, attach a document, or drop photos here. Drag-and-drop zone with a file list showing names, sizes, and upload progress per file.
tagsinput: Add tags, enter skills, or label something with multiple keywords. Chip-style input to type entries one at a time, accept suggestions, and remove any chip.
numberstepper: How many guests? Set a quantity, adjust serving size, or enter a count with min/max bounds. Plus/minus stepper for any numeric value within a range.
searchselect: Search and pick from a long list, filter options by typing, or find a country, city, or category to choose. Searchable dropdown with live filtering and keyboard navigation.
formpanel: Fill out a contact form, sign up, or collect info with multiple fields and validation. Multi-field form with text, email, select, and textarea inputs plus a submit button.
modal: Show a popup dialog when a button is clicked. I need a centered overlay with a title, body text, and action buttons like OK and Cancel.
confirmdialog: Are you sure you want to delete this? I need a dangerous-action warning that stops users before they proceed — red button, bold alert styling, 'this cannot be undone' tone.
drawer: Slide a panel in from the side when a button is clicked. I need a right-side drawer that opens with a scrollable list of rows inside.
sheet: Show a bottom sheet with choices to tap. I need a mobile-native action sheet that slides up from the bottom of the screen with a list of selectable options.
popover: Show extra info when someone clicks this element. I need a small anchored popup with an arrow pointing at its trigger, revealing detail or a key stat without leaving the page.
hovercard: Show a rich preview card when hovering over a username or mention. I need a hover popup with someone's name, photo, bio, and a few key stats.
tooltip: Add helpful labels that appear on hover. I need styled tooltips on buttons and icons, with control over which side they appear — top, bottom, left, or right.
menu: Open a dropdown menu on click with actions and shortcuts. I need a desktop-style menu that groups options with icons, keyboard hints, and separating lines.
contextmenu: Right-click on something to see a context menu of actions. I need a menu that appears wherever the user right-clicks — options like edit, copy, delete, share.
commandk: Add a Cmd+K command palette to search and run any action by typing. I need a fuzzy-searchable list of commands grouped by category with keyboard navigation.
navbar: Design a header for my website. Show me a top nav with logo, links, and search. What does a typical app bar look like? A top-of-page brand + navigation links + user avatar layout.
sidenav: Show me a sidebar menu for a dashboard. Design grouped nav items with icons and active highlighting. Left-side panel with sections, icon rows, and badge counts.
breadcrumb: Where am I in the site? Show a path trail for nested pages or folders. Navigation that collapses when the hierarchy gets deep — with overflow into a dropdown ellipsis menu.
pagination: How do I page through search results or a long list? Show numbered page controls with prev/next arrows. A page selector with first/last buttons, item counts, and page jumps.
menubar: Design a desktop app menu bar with File, Edit, View dropdowns. Show a native-app-style menu with submenus and keyboard shortcuts. Multi-column dropdown menus at the top of an app.
megamenu: Show a big dropdown with multiple columns on hover. What does a mega-menu look like? A wide multi-column nav panel with grouped links, section headers, and an optional promo tile.
toolbar: Show a text editor toolbar with bold, italic, and alignment buttons. What does a formatting toolbar look like? Grouped icon buttons with toggle states and dividers for a rich-text editor.
commandbar: Show bulk actions when multiple rows are selected. What appears when I check several items in a table? A floating action bar with a live selection count and context actions like delete, move, or export.
treeview: Show a file explorer tree with nested folders. Display a directory structure with expand/collapse. What does a project file tree look like? Recursive folder nesting with selection, like a VS Code sidebar.
bottomnav: Design a mobile app's bottom tab bar. What does iOS/Android bottom navigation look like? Show Home, Search, and Profile icons at the bottom of the screen with an active indicator.
avatar: Show a user profile picture or initials badge. Who is this person / display this user's avatar with their name and current online status.
avatargroup: Who's on the team? Show all members of a group, collaborators on a project, or participants in a call as a compact overlapping avatar stack with overflow count.
badgeset: What are the statuses or tags here? Show category labels, priority badges, feature flags, or per-item notification counts as compact colored pills.
chipset: Let me pick or filter by tags. Selectable and removable topic chips, skill tags, filter categories, or interest labels the user can toggle on and off.
kbd: What's the keyboard shortcut for X? Show me the hotkeys or keybindings for this app — shortcuts rendered as styled key caps like ⌘K or Ctrl+C.
codeblock: Show me the code. Write a function in Python / TypeScript / Rust / SQL — any real source snippet rendered with full syntax highlighting and a copy button.
banner: Show a warning or site-wide announcement. Display an alert strip, promo banner, error notice, or call-to-action ribbon with a tone color and dismiss button.
toaststack: Show a success / error / info pop-up notification. Brief toast messages that appear momentarily after an action — stacked, auto-dismissing, non-blocking alerts.
spinner: Show a loading state or spinner. Animated loading indicators — circular spinners, indeterminate progress bars, or loading button states for async operations.
notification: Show my notifications or recent activity feed. A notification inbox with unread dots, time-ago stamps, sender avatars, and a mark-all-read action.
componentapi: What props does this component take? What are all the parameters for this function or hook? Shows the API contract — prop names, types, required flags, defaults, and what each one does.
stacktrace: I'm getting a TypeError / crash — what's wrong and how do I fix it? Help me debug this exception. Shows error type, the full call stack frame by frame, root cause, and a plain-language fix.
syntaxbreakdown: Explain this code line by line — I don't understand this snippet. What does each part do? Annotates every line in plain English with color-coded labels on keywords, types, and operators.
codewalk: How does this algorithm work step by step? Walk me through binary search / quicksort / BFS with actual code. Numbered steps each pairing a code snippet with a plain-English explanation of what's happening.
terminal: How do I run / set up / deploy this? Show me the git / npm / docker / CLI commands. Renders a realistic terminal session with prompt-prefixed commands, color-coded stdout/stderr, and a final exit-code badge.
logstream: Help me read these logs — what went wrong? Filter the errors and warnings from the noise. Shows a severity-coded log feed with timestamp, level pill, source tag, and per-level chips you can filter by.
gitgraph: Show my git history / branching strategy. How do feature branches merge back to main? Explain what happened in this repo's commits visually — drawn as branch lanes, merges, tags, and HEAD like `git log --graph`.
queryplan: Why is this SQL query slow? Explain the EXPLAIN / query plan output. Shows the operation tree with rows, cost, and time per step, and flags the bottleneck so you know where to add an index.
flamegraph: Where is my app spending all its CPU time? What's the hot path / bottleneck in my profile? Shows a flame graph where call-stack depth is height, time spent is width, and the hot path is highlighted.
regexscope: Can you explain this regex / regular expression? What does this pattern match? Breaks it down token by token with color-coded labels, then highlights which parts of a test string each group catches.
voicestyle: Write this in my voice. Make it sound like me, not generic AI copy. Captures your personal style traits, then shows the same line before and after rewriting it in your own voice.
messagedraft: Write an email to my landlord about the broken heater. Draft a message asking for a deadline extension. A polished email or message with subject, tone, and body — ready to copy and send.
chatthread: Show this text exchange as a chat thread. Display these messages as bubbles. Recreate a WhatsApp or iMessage-style conversation with timestamps and names on each side.
dialogue: Write a dialogue between a teacher and student explaining photosynthesis. Show a sample interview between a doctor and patient. Scripted back-and-forth with alternating spoken lines per character.
variants: Give me 3 versions of this email with different tones. Write a formal and casual alternative. Show A/B subject line options. Multiple labeled rewrites of the same message side by side.
verse: Write a poem about missing someone. Write song lyrics for a melancholy indie track. Compose a haiku or sonnet. Stanza-structured literary text with proper form labels and indentation.
slidedeck: Make a presentation on climate change. Give me a slide deck outline for a pitch to investors. Include speaker notes. One card per slide with title, bullets, speaker notes, and layout hints.
screenplay: Write a screenplay scene where two characters argue in a diner. Format this as a script. Script a short film opening. Industry-standard sluglines, action lines, character cues, and indented dialogue.
quadrant: Plot these on a 2x2 matrix. Where do they fall on effort vs impact? Magic quadrant, priority matrix, or Eisenhower box placing items in four quadrants by two axes.
piedonut: Show the breakdown as a pie chart. What share is each category? The percentage split of a budget or total as a pie or donut of parts of a whole.
distributioncurve: Show the bell curve / normal distribution. Where does this score fall? A smooth distribution curve with the mean and standard deviations marked.
sensitivitytable: How does the outcome change if price and volume vary? A two-variable what-if sensitivity table of results across two input ranges.
labpanel: Show my blood test results. Are my cholesterol and glucose normal? Measured lab values against reference ranges, flagged high or low.
ingredientmatrix: What ingredients go in each dish? Compare recipes by what they share. A grid of ingredients across several recipes or items.
conjugation: Conjugate the Spanish verb hablar. Show the present tense of être. A verb conjugation table across persons and tenses.
latencydist: Show the p50, p95, and p99 latency. What's the response-time distribution? Latency percentiles for performance and tail behavior.
captable: Show the startup cap table. Who owns what equity after the round? Ownership percentages by shareholder and share class.
financialstatement: Show the income statement or balance sheet. What's the P&L? Revenue, expenses, and net income as line items.
cohortgrid: Show retention by signup cohort. How many users come back each week? A cohort retention grid by period.
riskmatrix: Show a risk matrix of probability versus impact. Rank risks by likelihood and severity in a likelihood-by-impact grid.
careplan: Show a patient care plan. What are the nursing problems, goals, and interventions? A structured plan of problems and actions.
doseladder: Show the pain-relief medication ladder. How do I step up the dose? An escalating dose or treatment ladder by severity.
lifewheel: Rate my life balance across work, health, and relationships. A wheel-of-life self-assessment scoring satisfaction in each area.
sizechart: What size should I order? Show the clothing size chart mapping measurements to sizes S, M, and L.
toulmin: Break down this argument using the Toulmin model. What are the grounds, warrant, and claim? Map the logical structure: grounds, warrant, backing, qualifier, rebuttal.
castmap: Map the relationships between the characters. Who's friends, rivals, or family? Show the character web with typed connections.
storyarc: Show the plot structure as a Freytag pyramid. What's the three-act structure of this story? Map the hero's journey stages. Show the Save the Cat beats.
devicemark: Identify the rhetorical devices in this passage. Mark the literary techniques. Highlight the metaphors, similes, and alliteration in the text.
etymtree: What is the etymology of this word? Show the word origin and root. Where does this word come from? Show the Latin and Greek roots.
